name: goal
description: Goal orchestration tools (parent-only). Lets a parent LLM pull the status of a long-horizon goal it delegated to a background Goal Agent (two-plane non-blocking model, Phase 19b-gamma). Execution happens in-process inside the MCP server via direct dispatcher handlers (see ubp_mcp_server.tools.subagent_orchestration_handlers); this manifest exists ONLY for tool discovery and pack/ACL filtering — there is intentionally no adapter.py / providers.py. The Goal Record (ubp:goal:*) is the single source of truth; these tools are a read-only access layer over it.
author: UBP Team

execution.notes: Tools are NOT routed through the backend HTTP /api/modules path. The MCP ToolDispatcher invokes the registered direct handlers in-process; this manifest is consumed only by manifest_converter.discover_all_tools() to surface the goal tools to the pack/ACL pipeline. The goal__pull_status handler is registered by the same register_subagent_orchestration entrypoint that wires the subagent orchestration handlers.

operations.name: pull_status
operations.description: Pull the status of the long-horizon goal the caller delegated to a background Goal Agent in the current session (two-plane non-blocking). Reads the Goal Record (single source of truth) by session. Returns the active or most-recent goal for this session, or null if none was delegated. Parent-only, read-only. Use this when the user asks how a delegated/background task is progressing.
